video_title: Sam Amick Gives UPDATE on Jaylen Brown and Giannis Antetokounmpo Trade Talks

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks owner Jimmy Haslam has set a clear timeline for the draft
quotes.excerpt: It's not often when you have an owner publicly set a timeline, right? So he has said the draft

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Manning
text_blocks.text: How have you seen that evolve and where do things stand now in terms of their potential interest in him and that actually happening?

text_blocks.speaker: Sam Amick
text_blocks.text: It's interesting. I love the timing of it here where you had Jimmy Haslam, the Bucks owner. It's not often when you have an owner publicly set a timeline, right? So he has said the draft, June 23rd, they want to get something done. So that clock is ticking.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Boston showed early interest in Giannis Antetokounmpo during the trade deadline
quotes.excerpt: Boston showed some cursory interest and there were signs that they were kicking that around

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Manning
text_blocks.text: How have you seen that evolve and where do things stand now in terms of their potential interest in him and that actually happening?

text_blocks.speaker: Sam Amick
text_blocks.text: If you go back to the February trade deadline, I had been told that Boston showed some cursory interest and there were signs that they were kicking that around in the office and trying to get a feel for how the big fellow might feel about it.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics internal dynamics remain a sensitive factor for potential trade moves
quotes.excerpt: They've got to be sensitive to their own internal dynamics. We know that Jason and Jaylen have been trying to get on the same page

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Manning
text_blocks.text: Where do things stand now in terms of their potential interest in him and that actually happening?

text_blocks.speaker: Sam Amick
text_blocks.text: They to me are one of those teams where for very obvious reasons they've got to be sensitive to their own internal dynamics. We know that Jason and Jaylen have been trying to get on the same page. They win the title together. Then you had Jaylen make his public comments in the postseason after the playoffs that had people talking.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo is evaluating potential rosters for a future trade
quotes.excerpt: There are signs that he's looking at what that roster in Miami might look like after a trade

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Manning
text_blocks.text: What did you see that compelled you and us to highlight the Celtics?

text_blocks.speaker: Sam Amick
text_blocks.text: From Giannis's point of view, doesn't mean he's not excited potentially about Miami, but there are signs that he's looking at what that roster in Miami might look like after a trade and hypothetically comparing it to what a roster might look like in Boston after a trade.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo is seeking a serious organization and hard coaching
quotes.excerpt: The theme between Boston and Miami is that Giannis is ready for a really serious organization

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Manning
text_blocks.text: How powerful is that if he does see the Celtics as the place where he can win most?

text_blocks.speaker: Sam Amick
text_blocks.text: The theme between Boston and Miami is that Giannis is ready for a really serious organization. The praise of Joe Mazzulla speaks to that. I think he wants to be coached hard right now.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics are not actively shopping Jaylen Brown despite media speculation
quotes.excerpt: There's no signs that they're putting Jaylen out there at all. In fact, they've gone to great lengths

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Manning
text_blocks.text: Is that something that they would seriously look at, moving Jaylen for someone that isn't Giannis?

text_blocks.speaker: Sam Amick
text_blocks.text: There's no signs that they're putting Jaylen out there at all. In fact, they've gone to great lengths after he made those comments after the season to make sure that they were good with him, and all the messaging from the organization and from Jaylen's camp was that nothing to see here, media talk. Brad Stevens made it clear that the messaging from Jaylen to him was that he's good.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks would likely flip Jaylen Brown for young assets if traded
quotes.excerpt: I think they would probably be trying to look at his market and to flip him for a bunch of young pieces

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Manning
text_blocks.text: How do you see it playing out on the Giannis front?

text_blocks.speaker: Sam Amick
text_blocks.text: If some talks did happen with Jaylen, I think they would probably be trying to look at his market and to flip him for a bunch of young pieces. I don't necessarily think that if that did unfold that Jaylen would be in a Bucks jersey.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks GM John Horst is known for keeping trade talks quiet
quotes.excerpt: John Horst, the Bucks GM, is very good at going into bunker mode and keeping things tight

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Manning
text_blocks.text: What do you think will happen there ultimately?

text_blocks.speaker: Sam Amick
text_blocks.text: John Horst, the Bucks GM, is very good at going into bunker mode and keeping things tight. So I don't know what John has on his desk.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Brad Stevens is prioritizing rim protection and rim pressure for the roster
quotes.excerpt: Brad kind of gave everybody the playbook and said we need more rim pressure, rim protection

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Manning
text_blocks.text: What could you see them doing if they do keep that core together?

text_blocks.speaker: Sam Amick
text_blocks.text: Brad kind of gave everybody the playbook and said we need more rim pressure, rim protection. Really in some ways he described the best version of Kristaps Porzingis from the previous title team. So finding a guy like that, I don't know. Miles Turner comes to mind.
